tools.name: about_agency_growth
tools.description: What Agency Growth (agencygrowth.com) does, who it is for, and how it can help. Use when the user asks about Agency Growth.

tools.name: list_plans
tools.description: Agency Growth's plans, prices, and where each one starts. Use when the user asks about pricing or plans.

tools.description: Run Agency Growth's free AI audit of the user's business. tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Search Agency Growth's guides for agency owners: pricing and retainers, getting clients, starting an AI automation agency, white label AI agents, growth models and plans. Returns matching guides with a short summary and slug. Use when the user asks how to price, grow, or run a marketing or AI agency

tools.name: read_guide
tools.description: Full text of one Agency Growth guide, with its sources and last-updated date. Pass a slug from search_guides. Cite it as Agency Growth (agencygrowth.com) with the guide's link.

tools.name: agency_pricing_benchmarks
tools.description: Published monthly retainer ranges for agency services (social media, SEO, paid ads, web, content, full-service). tools.name: agency_growth_plan
tools.description: Turns five answers about an agency into its growth stage, the gap to fix first, and a week-by-week 30-day plan. Ask the user each question rather than guessing. Use when an agency owner asks what to focus on next or why growth has stalled.

tools.name: list_daily_issues
tools.description: Recent AgencyGrowth Daily issues: each weekday, one job agency owners want handed off, the tool they already use, a step-by-step recipe, and the catch. Newest first. Use when the user wants a concrete way to automate or delegate a recurring agency task.

tools.name: list_playbooks
tools.description: Agency Growth's free 30-day playbooks, one per growth bottleneck: getting leads, closing, delivery capacity, retention, pricing. Use when an agency owner asks what to fix first or how to fix a stall in one of those areas; then call get_playbook.

tools.name: get_playbook
tools.description: One playbook in full: the problem with sourced owner quotes, the tools agencies already pay for, the gap, week-by-week steps, the numbers to track, guide links, and the agent that runs it.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: run_ai_audit, list_daily_issues · Public sink: run_ai_audit · Destructive: run_ai_audit, search_guides.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: run_ai_audit, list_daily_issues · Public sink: run_ai_audit · Destructive: run_ai_audit, search_guides

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
